note: The card creator's own wording for triggers and keywords (Revival, not game text). status: official = used by official cards; untested = fires in the game's code but no official card uses it; dead = never fires (hidden). check = wording still to be confirmed.

ThisCardPlayed.name: When this card is played
ThisCardPlayed.text: When you play this card from your hand. On troops this is Rally; on stratagems, their main effect.

Talent.name: Talent (warlords)
Talent.text: A warlord's Talent: at the start of your turn it puts the warlord's Talent stratagem (Ephemeral) in your hand.

Codex.name: Codex
Codex.text: Ultramarines. Triggers when your energy reaches 0.

WhileInPlayVariable.name: While in play (amount follows a count)
WhileInPlayVariable.text: A lasting effect while this card is in play, whose size follows a count (e.g. for each friendly troop).

WhileInPlay.name: While in play
WhileInPlay.text: A lasting effect while this card is in play: auras such as "other units have ..." or "your stratagems cost 1 less".

Strike.name: Strike
Strike.text: After this unit attacks, if it survives. "The chosen target" is the unit it attacked.

FollowUpResolution.name: Then, after this card's effects
FollowUpResolution.text: Right after this card's own effects have resolved: used for follow-ups such as "if the target dies, ..." or "if it has a Hunt Mark, ..." (narrow it with "event hit").

OtherUnitDeath.name: When another unit dies
OtherUnitDeath.text: When a unit dies. "Event hit" says whose death counts (e.g. a friendly troop); with "Triggered by: this card" it means units this card destroyed.

UseFaith.name: Faith (Sororitas)
UseFaith.text: When your total Faith reaches the amount set in "Costs points": the "6 Faith: ..." abilities.

UseSpiritStone.name: Spirit Stone (Aeldari)
UseSpiritStone.text: Spends collected Spirit Stones (the amount in "Costs points") for this ability: Waystone units' "Spirit Stone: ..." effects.

TurnEnd.name: At the end of a turn
TurnEnd.text: At the end of a turn. Pick whose turn under "Whose turn".

TurnStart.name: At the start of a turn
TurnStart.text: At the start of a turn. Pick whose turn under "Whose turn".

TurnStartPlayer.name: At the start of your turn
TurnStartPlayer.text: At the start of its owner's turn ("has Flying during your turn", "at the start of your turn, return to your hand").

TurnBeforeEnd.name: Just before the end of a turn
TurnBeforeEnd.text: Just before the end-of-turn effects run (Chronomancer reanimates a Remnant here).

Pray.name: Pray
Pray.text: When this unit prays (uses its Pray action). Every official Pray card gives the praying state with it.

Slay.name: Slay
Slay.text: After this unit attacks and destroys a unit, if it survives.

Artifice.name: Artifice
Artifice.text: Each time you play a stratagem.

OtherUnitSummoned.name: When another unit enters play
OtherUnitSummoned.text: When another unit is deployed or summoned. "Triggered by" says which ones (e.g. friendly Vehicles).

ThisUnitSummoned.name: When this unit enters play
ThisUnitSummoned.text: When this unit is deployed or summoned, also when another card puts it into play (unlike "when this card is played").

Unstable.name: Unstable
Unstable.text: Goff. When this unit dies: official cards deal 1-3 damage to a random unit.

Mob.name: Mob
Mob.text: After a friendly troop makes a melee attack.

EarnedSkull.name: When a skull is earned
EarnedSkull.text: When a player earns a Skull. Official cards using it are environment cards (storms, eclipses).

OtherCardPlayed.name: When another card is played
OtherCardPlayed.text: When another card is played. "Triggered by" says which (e.g. your stratagems, your Secrets).

UnitAttack.name: When a unit attacks
UnitAttack.text: When a unit attacks: this unit unless "Triggered by" says otherwise. "The chosen target" is the unit being attacked.

AboutToAttack.name: Just before a unit attacks
AboutToAttack.text: Just before a unit attacks, so the attack can still be changed (Vargard Obyron takes attacks aimed at your warlord).

Regiment.name: Regiment
Regiment.text: Astra Militarum. When another friendly unit makes a ranged attack.

Ambush.name: Ambush
Ambush.text: Genestealer Cults. Played face down; if it is not damaged before your next turn, it is revealed and this triggers.

Ecstasy.name: Ecstasy
Ecstasy.text: Emperor's Children. When this unit's health drops to the number or less without it dying.

Stimulation.name: Stimulation
Stimulation.text: Emperor's Children. When this unit is targeted by a stratagem, before the stratagem resolves.

Cruelty.name: Cruelty
Cruelty.text: Emperor's Children. When an enemy unit is damaged but not destroyed during your turn.

Uprising.name: Uprising
Uprising.text: Genestealer Cults. Each time another troop is deployed after this one, on the turn this one was deployed.

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.text: Dark Angels. If this card is played on the same turn it was drawn.

Rage.name: Penitence
Rage.text: Sororitas. When this unit is damaged but not destroyed. (The game calls the trigger Rage; card text says Penitence.)

Reanimated.name: When a Remnant is reanimated
Reanimated.text: Necrons. When a Remnant comes back to life: this one, or the ones "event hit" names.

UnitReceivesMarkOfChaos.name: When a unit receives a Dark Pact
UnitReceivesMarkOfChaos.text: Black Legion. When a unit receives a Dark Pact (Mark of Chaos).

TriggerEnchantment.name: Enchantment's effect
TriggerEnchantment.text: The ability of an enchantment card: it runs on the unit the enchantment is attached to (the Dark Pacts).

OnCollectSpiritStone.name: When you collect a Spirit Stone
OnCollectSpiritStone.text: Aeldari. When you collect a Spirit Stone.

QuestTriggered.name: When a quest completes
QuestTriggered.text: Dark Angels. When a Quest is completed (every 3 Quest points add a Secret to your deck).

OnCollectQuestPoints.name: When you gain Quest points
OnCollectQuestPoints.text: Dark Angels. When you or a friendly unit gains Quest points.

UnitDeathByAbility.name: When a unit dies to this ability
UnitDeathByAbility.text: When a unit dies from this card's ability: the "if the target dies, ..." part of damage abilities.

PlayedThirdCardInTurn.name: When the third card of a turn is played
PlayedThirdCardInTurn.text: When a player plays their third card in a turn.

TriggeredFerocity.name: When a friendly unit uses Ferocity
TriggeredFerocity.text: Space Wolves. When a friendly unit uses its Ferocity action.

TriggeredPray.name: When a friendly unit prays
TriggeredPray.text: Sororitas. When a friendly unit uses its Pray action.

TriggeredSynapse.name: When a friendly unit triggers Synapse
TriggeredSynapse.text: Tyranids. When a friendly unit's Synapse repeats a stratagem.

TriggeredSwarm.name: When a friendly unit triggers Swarm
TriggeredSwarm.text: Tyranids. When a friendly unit combines through Swarm.

TriggeredCodex.name: When a friendly card triggers Codex
TriggeredCodex.text: Ultramarines. When a friendly troop or stratagem triggers Codex (Avenging Zeal works from your hand).

TriggeredDuty.name: When a friendly unit uses Duty
TriggeredDuty.text: Astra Militarum. When a friendly unit uses its Duty action.

UnitDamaged.name: When a unit is damaged
UnitDamaged.text: When a unit takes damage from anything. "Event hit" says which units count (e.g. your warlord).

OnSabotageCreated.name: When you create a Sabotage
OnSabotageCreated.text: When a Sabotage card is created.

SpentAllMana.name: When a player spends all their energy
SpentAllMana.text: When a player has spent all their energy.

UnitReceivesHuntMark.name: When a unit gets a Hunt Mark
UnitReceivesHuntMark.text: Space Wolves. When a unit gets a Hunt Mark.

UnitReceivesMarkerlight.name: When a unit gets Markerlight
UnitReceivesMarkerlight.text: T'au. When a unit gets Markerlight.

UnitStunned.name: When a unit is stunned
UnitStunned.text: When a unit is stunned. "The chosen target" is the stunned unit.

OtherCardMob.name: When another unit triggers Mob
OtherCardMob.text: Goff. When a friendly unit triggers Mob.

OtherCardSpiritStone.name: When another card uses Spirit Stones
OtherCardSpiritStone.text: Aeldari. When another card triggers a Spirit Stone ability.

Agenda.name: Reacts when this unit uses Agenda
Agenda.text: A separate ability that reacts when this unit uses its Agenda action (the Agenda action itself is set up as an Action keyword; official Agenda cards put everything in the action).

Duty.name: Reacts when this unit uses Duty
Duty.text: A separate ability that reacts when this unit uses its Duty action (the Duty action itself is set up as an Action keyword; official Duty cards put everything in the action).

Ferocity.name: Reacts when this unit uses Ferocity
Ferocity.text: A separate ability that reacts when this unit uses its Ferocity action (the Ferocity action itself is set up as an Action keyword; official Ferocity cards put everything in the action).

Courtesy.name: Courtesy
Courtesy.text: At the end of a turn, under a condition read from the card.

Resolution.name: Resolution
Resolution.text: At the end of a turn, for cards with the Resolution keyword.

Relentless.name: Relentless
Relentless.text: At the start of a turn (and when another card sets off Relentless).

Landing.name: Landing
Landing.text: At the start of a turn, after units arriving by Reactor or Transient have landed.

Requiem.name: Requiem
Requiem.text: When this unit dies, for cards with the Requiem keyword.

Sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
Sacrifice.text: When a unit with the Sacrifice keyword is sacrificed.

Survivor.name: Survivor
Survivor.text: When the Survivor keyword saves this unit from dying.

UnitDamagedByAbility.name: When a unit is damaged by an ability
UnitDamagedByAbility.text: When a unit takes damage from an ability (not an attack).

UnitDamagedByAttack.name: When a unit is damaged by an attack
UnitDamagedByAttack.text: When a unit takes damage from an attack.

TurnSetup.name: At the set-up of a turn
TurnSetup.text: At the set-up step of a turn, before "at the start of a turn".

Mutated.name: When this unit mutates
Mutated.text: When a mutation buff lands on this unit.

Support.name: Support
Support.text: When a unit is deployed next to this one, for cards with the Support keyword.

TriggerOnceIfBoardCriteria.name: Once, when the condition becomes true
TriggerOnceIfBoardCriteria.text: Fires once, at the moment the ability's "Only if" condition becomes true.

Growth.name: Growth
Growth.text: Never fires: no code in the game sets this trigger off, so an ability on it does nothing.

HeroDefenseBonus.name: Hero Defense Bonus
HeroDefenseBonus.text: Never fires: no code in the game sets this trigger off, so an ability on it does nothing.

TurnStarted.name: Turn Started
TurnStarted.text: Never fires: no code in the game sets this trigger off, so an ability on it does nothing.

UnitDeathByPoison.name: Unit Death By Poison
UnitDeathByPoison.text: Never fires: no code in the game sets this trigger off, so an ability on it does nothing.

UnitDeathAttacking.name: Unit Death Attacking
UnitDeathAttacking.text: Never fires: no code in the game sets this trigger off, so an ability on it does nothing.

CardCreatedInHand.name: Card Created In Hand
CardCreatedInHand.text: Never fires: no code in the game sets this trigger off, so an ability on it does nothing.

OtherCardSacrifice.name: Other Card Sacrifice
OtherCardSacrifice.text: Never fires: no code in the game sets this trigger off, so an ability on it does nothing.

Pack.name: Pack
Pack.text: Never fires: no code in the game sets this trigger off, so an ability on it does nothing.

ThisCardDrawnAsTrap.name: This Card Drawn As Trap
ThisCardDrawnAsTrap.text: Never fires: no code in the game sets this trigger off, so an ability on it does nothing.

TrapResolved.name: Trap Resolved
TrapResolved.text: Never fires: no code in the game sets this trigger off, so an ability on it does nothing.

UnitPoisoned.name: Unit Poisoned
UnitPoisoned.text: Never fires: no code in the game sets this trigger off, so an ability on it does nothing.

ThisUnitAbilityUsed.name: This Unit Ability Used
ThisUnitAbilityUsed.text: Never fires: no code in the game sets this trigger off, so an ability on it does nothing.

SurvivorSpent.name: Survivor Spent
SurvivorSpent.text: Never fires: no code in the game sets this trigger off, so an ability on it does nothing.

CardReturnedToHand.name: Card Returned To Hand
CardReturnedToHand.text: Never fires: no code in the game sets this trigger off, so an ability on it does nothing.

CardReturnedToDeck.name: Card Returned To Deck
CardReturnedToDeck.text: Never fires: no code in the game sets this trigger off, so an ability on it does nothing.

Combo.name: Combo
Combo.text: Never fires: no code in the game sets this trigger off, so an ability on it does nothing.

Oath.name: Oath
Oath.text: Never fires: no code in the game sets this trigger off, so an ability on it does nothing.

frenzied.name: Destroyer
frenzied.text: Always attacks a unit it can destroy before any other unit.

rage.name: Penitence
rage.text: Sororitas. Triggers an effect when this unit is damaged but not destroyed (the game's name is Rage).

oathDouble.name: Oath twice
oathDouble.text: Friendly Oath abilities apply an additional time (Chaplain Cassius).

unstoppable.name: Ignores Vanguard
unstoppable.text: This troop can ignore enemy units with Vanguard when attacking.

none.name: (empty keyword slot)
none.text: An empty entry in the card's keyword list, as on one official card. Does nothing by itself.
